tournament.name: Pre-jam ladder
tournament._comment_backend: jev-schema = the Jam's path for BOTH sides: entrant prose -> tools/jev/compile.py (once per prompt hash + compiler version) -> schema_server.py -> Jev; the house plays its tier's checked-in schemas (docs/arena-site-spec.md §9). qwen9b stays below as a named, non-default backend
tournament._comment_map: pinned so a change to the runner's DEFAULT_MAP never silently moves the ladder; pvp-1 is today's default (src/mapVariant.ts)

jev-schema._comment: tools/jev/schema_server.py (TypeSafe, failing over to Workers AI -- both Jev). Ladder matches AND compile-panel practice matches. Spend: ~$0.06 a full match, ~$0.01 a quick one; dailyBudgetUsd holds new matches once today's (Central) Jev spend on this backend reaches it, maxUsdPerMatch stops one match. A side with more than maxUnansweredRate of its decisions unanswered fails the match (re-queued once); null turns a limit off

qwen9b._comment: the old text-model ladder (tools/model_server.py, local Ollama). Not the default: set tournament.backend to qwen9b (or --backend qwen9b) to play prose prompts on qwen3.5:9b again

jev-house._comment: tools/jev/house_server.py's hand-written cascade; SHADOW ONLY and text-model ladders only -- on a jev-schema ladder the house plays house.schemas instead (runs/jev-house-bot-2026-09-23.md)

house._comment_tier: medium = the placement bar (prompts/pilots/house-{violet,green}.md, on Jev prompts/pilots/house-medium.schemas.json). easy | hard play those pairs/schemas instead (runs/house-tiers-2026-09-30.md); a different house is a different placement bar. Set tier or files, not both
house._comment_schemas: null = the tier's checked-in compile, prompts/pilots/house-<tier>.schemas.json; a path here plays that file instead. Required on a jev-schema ladder
house._comment_backend: text-model ladders only: 'jev-house' makes the house side play the shadow Jev house bot. Ignored on a jev-schema ladder

compile._comment: the /compile panel (docs/entrant-compile-preview.md) AND the ladder's own compiles of entrant prose for Jev: both run tools/jev/compile.py server-side on this backend (ollama = host Ollama, $OLLAMA_HOST; openrouter = hosted, $OPENROUTER_API_KEY in the arena's environment). The rate limits below are the panel's; ladder compiles are once per prompt and not limited
compile._comment_ipHeader: behind the Cloudflare Tunnel every request comes from 127.0.0.1 -- set to "cf-connecting-ip" there so the per-IP limits are per visitor
